categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies `test/functional/wallet_migration.py`, which validates the legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration path and wallet directory listings.
categories.rationale: Tightens assertions in `wallet_migration.py` to ensure regression testing catches migration and wallet listing bugs. Commit messages show mutation diffs where existing tests passed even when `ListDatabases` dropped BDB paths, `.bak` filtering was omitted, or wrapped P2WSH scripts were unverified.
